blocks.text: Pani ke molecules harkat ki tawanai (kinetic energy) rakhte hain: mai (liquid) ya gas ki shakal mein yeh tezi aur be-tarteebi se jagah jagah harkat karte hain. Kisi nizam (system) mein pani ke molecules ki concentration jitni zyada, un ki kul kinetic energy utni zyada; yehi water potential hai, jise Yunani harf psi (Ψw) se zahir karte hain. Podon ke cells mein do cheezein water potential tai karti hain: solute potential (Ψs) aur pressure potential (Ψp).

Khalis (pure) pani ka water potential sab se zyada hai, jo tareef ke mutabiq sifar hai. Pani zyada Ψw wale ilaqe se kam Ψw wale ilaqe ki taraf jata hai. Tamam mahlool (solutions) ka Ψw khalis pani se kam hota hai aur is liye un ka Ψw manfi (negative) hota hai (fizai dabao aur muqarrar darja-hararat par). Is liye osmosis ki tareef yun ki ja sakti hai: pani ke molecules ka zyada water potential wale ilaqe se kam water potential wale ilaqe ki taraf juzwi tor par guzarne wali (partially permeable) jhilli ke zariye harkat.

blocks.title: Solute potential (Ψs)
blocks.text: Solute potential, ya osmotic potential, kisi nizam ke water potential mein woh tabdeeli hai jo solute molecules ki maujoodgi se hoti hai. Yeh hamesha manfi hota hai: jitne zyada solute molecules maujood, Ψs utna kam (zyada manfi).

blocks.title: Pressure potential (Ψp)
blocks.text: Water potential ka woh hissa jo pani ke dale hue dabao (pressure) se hai. Agar khalis pani ya mahlool par fizai dabao se zyada dabao dala jaye to us ka water potential barh jata hai. Jab pani osmosis se pode ke cell mein dakhil hota hai to andar dabao banta hai, cell turgid hota hai aur pressure potential barhta hai.

Kul water potential solute potential aur pressure potential ka majmua hai: Ψw = Ψs + Ψp. Water potential se kisi bhi do nizamon ke darmiyan pani ki harkat ka rujhan napa ja sakta hai, sirf pode mein cell se cell tak nahin balke mitti se jar tak, patte se hawa tak aur mitti se hawa tak bhi. Potential ki dhalan (gradient) jitni tez, pani us par utni tezi se behta hai.

blocks.caption: Water potential aur us ke hisse

blocks.prompt: Cell A ka solute potential manfi 800 kPa aur pressure potential 300 kPa hai; cell B ka solute potential manfi 600 kPa aur pressure potential 200 kPa hai. In ke darmiyan pani kis taraf jata hai, aur kyun?
blocks.explanation: A ka Ψw manfi 800 jama 300, yani manfi 500 kPa; B ka Ψw manfi 600 jama 200, yani manfi 400 kPa. Pani zyada water potential se kam ki taraf jata hai, is liye B (manfi 400) se A (manfi 500) ki taraf.

items: Water potential (Ψw) pani ki harkat ka rujhan hai; khalis pani sifar, tamam mahlool manfi, aur pani zyada se kam Ψw ki taraf behta hai. Osmosis yehi bahao partially permeable jhilli ke zariye hai.
Ψw = Ψs + Ψp: solute potential hamesha manfi hai aur zyada solute se girta hai; pressure potential turgid cell ke deewar par dabao se barhta hai.
Ψw ki dhalan pani ko mitti se jar, cell se cell, aur patte se hawa tak le jati hai; dhalan jitni tez, bahao utna tez.
